From: Rebecca Lim <rebecca@cloudnova.com>

Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Displacement economics — pilot scope and pricing ask

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the internal feasibility call this morning and the execs want a short pilot to validate inference cost delta and runtime parity before we commit to a broader replacement. Two quick asks from our side: 

- A simple decision matrix that maps: per-token unit cost (hosted vs. vendor), projected monthly spend at 10M, 50M tokens, and latency percentile impacts.
- A preview commercial offer for a 90-day pilot (non-exclusive) including any pilot credits, onboarding hours estimate, and suggested success criteria.

Procurement will need an early view of T&Cs — I can loop them in once we have the numbers. Can you send a short package by EOD tomorrow? Attaching our high-level pilot objectives for context.

Regards,
Rebecca
Head of AI Product
CloudNova

Attachment: cloudnova_pilot_objectives.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Displacement economics — pilot scope and pricing ask

Folks — forwarding Rebecca's note. Key constraints: CloudNova wants quick budget clarity + low-risk pilot. They called out 10M and 50M token scenarios.

Notes for offer:
- Pilot length: 90 days. Prefer non-exclusive so we can show uplift.
- Credit layering: 50% token credit up to $X for first 30 days, then staged credits if metrics met.
- Onboarding: estimate 40-60 engineering hours for runtime handoff/benchmarking.
- SLA: temporary 99.5% availability for pilot; procurement will ask standard terms.

Jordan — can you draft two commercial options: (A) Hosted-focused pilot with caching/burst credits and (B) Dedicated micro-pool with reserved throughput and lower per-token after credits. Include a small one-time setup fee for dedicated.

Marissa — please prepare a minimal SOW template (one page) we can attach.

Thanks,
Logan

--- Original message attached ---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Lim <rebecca@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, CloudNova Procurement <procurement@cloudnova.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Displacement economics — pilot scope and pricing ask

Rebecca — thanks for the objectives and the attachment. Please find a concise pilot package below (first-pass). I kept it tight so procurement can triage quickly.

Pilot option A — Hosted-first (fastest time-to-value):
- Length: 90 days
- Token credit: $20k consumption credit applied first 30 days
- Projected per-token cost (after credit) : $0.0009/token at 10M; $0.00075/token at 50M (estimates assume prefix caching optimization and 20% KV reuse)
- Onboarding: 25 engineering hours (runtime testing + prompt evaluation)
- Success criteria: p95 latency <= 220ms and Model parity ≥ 95% on eval set
- Attachments: pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx (pricing breakout)

Pilot option B — Dedicated micro-pool (predictable throughput):
- Length: 90 days
- One-time setup fee: $7,500 (reserved micro-pool allocation)
- Pilot credit: $12k applied to consumption; reduced per-token: $0.0006/token at 10M; $0.0005/token at 50M after credits
- Onboarding: 45 engineering hours (capacity handoff + quantization checks)
- Success criteria: p95 latency <= 180ms and integration test pass
- Additional note: Dedicated requires limited network peering work; approx 2 small maintenance windows.

Legal & procurement:
- We propose a short pilot MSA addendum with limited liability tied to pilot period. SOW-draft.docx attached for quick sign-off.

Decision matrix (attached): simple side-by-side values for OPEX vs. projected unit cost and ops effort.

Next steps: If one of these looks reasonable, can we lock a start date and I’ll ask Solutions to schedule a 2-hour kickoff?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx, SOW-draft.docx

From: Rebecca Lim <rebecca@cloudnova.com>

Subject: Re: Displacement economics — pilot scope and pricing ask

Jordan — appreciate the quick and detailed options. Procurement is looped now (CC). High level:

- Option B (Dedicated micro-pool) looks promising because our ops team wants predictable throughput and lower tail latency.
- Can you confirm the total estimated discount (credits + reduced per-token) against our current vendor spend at 50M tokens/month? Procurement will need a one-page cost comparison to their current rate.
- Legal: procurement asked for the pilot addendum and a copy of your SOC2 summary (they didn't ask for full attestation yet, just the summary).

If you can send the one-page cost comparison and the short MSA addendum today, we can aim to start the pilot week of Mar 21.

Best,

CloudNova
